description: Bilingual CS2 retrieval benchmark. Each concept has one English and one Chinese note; both are relevant to both of the concept's queries. Queries paraphrase rather than copy the notes, so keyword overlap is limited. Negative queries have no relevant note.

concepts.en: Mirage A execute: from T ramp and palace, smoke CT and jungle, flash over the A site wall, then plant default.
concepts.zh: Mirage A 区爆弹：从 T 坡和皇宫进攻，先封 CT 和丛林烟，越过 A 包点墙丢闪，再下默认包位。
concepts.q_en: how do we take bombsite A on mirage together
concepts.q_zh: Mirage 怎么五人一起打 A

concepts.en: Mirage top-mid window smoke: stand in T spawn against the wall, aim at the antenna, jump-throw. Blocks the AWP in window.
concepts.zh: Mirage 中路窗口烟：T 家贴墙站好，瞄天线，跳投。用来挡住窗口的狙击手。
concepts.q_en: block the sniper watching mid from the window on mirage
concepts.q_zh: 米拉中路被狙了怎么封

concepts.en: Dust2 B retake as CT: regroup at mid doors, flash into B from the doors, one player swings from window, clear back plat before the defuse.
concepts.zh: 炙热沙城 B 区回防：CT 在中门集合，从 B 门往里丢闪，一人从窗口拉出，下拆之前先清后平台。
concepts.q_en: taking B back after T plants on dust2
concepts.q_zh: D2 B 被下包后 CT 怎么回

concepts.en: Dust2 long doors: T throws a flash over the doors from outside long, the first player swings wide to catch the CT peeking from the pit or blue box.
concepts.zh: 炙热沙城 A 大门：T 从 A 大外把闪光丢过大门，第一个人大拉，抓从大坑或蓝箱探头的 CT。
concepts.q_en: winning the fight at the long A doors on dust2
concepts.q_zh: D2 A 大门对枪老是输怎么办

concepts.en: Dust2 Xbox smoke from T spawn: lets T cross mid to lower tunnels or catwalk without the CT seeing from mid doors.
concepts.zh: 沙城 X 箱烟：在 T 家丢出，T 可以安全过中路去下洞或 A 小，CT 从中门看不到。
concepts.q_en: safe way to cross the middle of dust2 to short
concepts.q_zh: 怎么安全过 D2 中路上 A 小

concepts.en: Nuke outside take: smoke cross and mini wall from T roof, then push outside to secret or garage while one player holds the CT outside angle.
concepts.zh: 核子危机外场控制：在 T 屋顶丢交叉烟和小墙烟，然后外场推进到暗道或车库，留一人看 CT 外场。
concepts.q_en: how to get control of the outdoor area on nuke
concepts.q_zh: Nuke 外面怎么控

concepts.en: Nuke hut push: pop-flash over the hut door into the A site, then clear heaven and hell before planting.
concepts.zh: 核子危机黄房进点：越过黄房门丢瞬爆闪进 A 包点，下包前先清天堂和地狱位置。
concepts.q_en: entering A site on nuke through the yellow room
concepts.q_zh: Nuke 从黄房进 A 怎么配合闪

concepts.en: Inferno banana control: T throws a molotov on the car and a smoke at CT, then takes the bottom of banana to set up a B execute.
concepts.zh: 炼狱小镇香蕉道控制：T 在车位丢燃烧弹、往 CT 丢烟，拿下香蕉道下方，为打 B 做准备。
concepts.q_en: how to win the narrow lane to B on inferno
concepts.q_zh: 炼狱香蕉道怎么拿

concepts.en: Inferno B execute: smoke CT and coffins, molotov new box, flash over the site, then plant behind the fountain.
concepts.zh: 炼狱 B 区爆弹：封 CT 烟和棺材烟，新箱子丢火，越过包点丢闪，然后在喷泉后面下包。
concepts.q_en: full team hit on the B site of inferno with utility
concepts.q_zh: 炼狱打 B 需要哪些道具

concepts.en: Ancient mid control: smoke the CT side of mid and the donut, then take mid to split pressure between A and B.
concepts.zh: 远古遗迹中路控制：封中路 CT 一侧和甜甜圈，拿下中路，给 A 和 B 两边施压。
concepts.q_en: taking the center of ancient
concepts.q_zh: 远古遗迹中路怎么打

concepts.en: After losing the pistol round with little money, save: buy nothing, keep the team's money together and full buy on the third round.
concepts.zh: 手枪局输了钱不够时要经济局：什么都不买，全队一起攒钱，第三局再全起。
concepts.q_en: what to buy after we lose the first round and are broke
concepts.q_zh: 输了手枪局没钱怎么办

concepts.en: Anti-eco: when the enemy is saving, play together at range with rifles and avoid close corners where pistols and shotguns win.
concepts.zh: 打对面经济局：对手在攒钱时，拿步枪保持距离一起打，不要去近点角落，那里手枪和霰弹枪更占优。
concepts.q_en: playing against a team with only pistols
concepts.q_zh: 对面只有手枪我们该怎么打

concepts.en: Post-plant: after the bomb is down, set a crossfire away from the bomb, don't peek, and save a molotov to stop the defuse.
concepts.zh: 下包后打法：包下了以后，离开包点架交叉火力，不要主动探头，留一颗燃烧弹阻止拆包。
concepts.q_en: what should T do once the C4 is planted
concepts.q_zh: 下完包怎么守

concepts.en: Retake basics: wait for teammates, enter the site together with flashes and smokes, and trade each other instead of going one by one.
concepts.zh: 回防要点：等队友到齐，带着闪光和烟一起进点，互相补枪，不要一个一个送。
concepts.q_en: how to get a bombsite back as defenders
concepts.q_zh: 回防总是一个一个送怎么改

concepts.en: 1v2 clutch: isolate one duel at a time, use sound to track both players, and play the time if the bomb is not planted.
concepts.zh: 1v2 残局：每次只打一个对枪，用脚步声判断两人的位置，没下包就拖时间。
concepts.q_en: last player alive against two enemies
concepts.q_zh: 一打二残局技巧

concepts.en: AWP: hold a long angle, reposition after each shot, and don't re-peek the same spot after you miss.
concepts.zh: 狙击（AWP）要点：架长距离位置，每开一枪就换位，打空之后不要从同一个点再探头。
concepts.q_en: tips for the sniper rifle
concepts.q_zh: 大狙怎么玩

concepts.en: Lurking: one T stays alone on the other side of the map, gathers information, and flanks at the timing of the main execute.
concepts.zh: 偷人（lurk）：一个 T 单独留在地图另一侧，收集信息，在主力进攻时从背后绕过去。
concepts.q_en: playing alone on the opposite side to catch rotators
concepts.q_zh: 一个人绕后怎么打

concepts.en: Trade kills: the second player stays close behind the entry so they can kill the enemy who just won the first duel.
concepts.zh: 补枪：第二个人紧跟在突破手身后，这样能马上击杀刚赢了第一枪的敌人。
concepts.q_en: following the entry fragger so his death is not wasted
concepts.q_zh: 队友第一个死了我怎么补

concepts.en: Fake: throw smokes and flashes at one site and make noise, then rotate the whole team to the other site.
concepts.zh: 假打：往一个包点丢烟和闪并制造声音，然后全队转到另一个包点。
concepts.q_en: pretend to hit one site then go to the other
concepts.q_zh: 怎么骗对面回防

concepts.en: Defuse kit: a kit cuts the defuse from 10 seconds to 5, so CT should buy one each round they can afford it.
concepts.zh: 拆弹器：拆弹钳把拆包时间从 10 秒缩短到 5 秒，CT 有钱就应该每局买。
concepts.q_en: how much faster is defusing with the kit
concepts.q_zh: 拆包钳能快几秒

concepts.en: Pop-flash: throw the flashbang so it bounces off a wall and explodes right as it comes into view, so enemies can't turn away.
concepts.zh: 瞬爆闪：让闪光弹撞墙反弹，一出现就爆炸，敌人来不及转身。
concepts.q_en: flashbang that blinds before they can react
concepts.q_zh: 闪光怎么丢才不会被躲掉

concepts.en: Jump-throw bind: bind jump and release attack to one key so smoke lineups land the same every time.
concepts.zh: 跳投绑定：把跳跃和松开左键绑定到一个键上，烟雾投掷点每次都能落在同一位置。
concepts.q_en: make my smoke lineups consistent
concepts.q_zh: 跳投烟老是扔歪

concepts.en: Economy: loss bonus grows with consecutive lost rounds; full buy when the whole team can afford rifles, armor and utility.
concepts.zh: 经济：连续输局会增加输局奖励；全队都买得起步枪、护甲和道具时再全起。
concepts.q_en: when should our team buy everything
concepts.q_zh: 什么时候全队全起

concepts.en: One-way smoke: stand at the edge of a smoke where you can see enemy feet below the cloud while they can't see you.
concepts.zh: 单向烟：站在烟雾边缘，你能看到烟下方敌人的脚，而他们看不到你。
concepts.q_en: seeing through the bottom of a smoke to get kills
concepts.q_zh: 单向烟怎么卡
